mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.7%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.0% month-over-month signals robust supply-side expansion, supporting corporate profit growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls above 135,000 thousand indicate strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 135,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.
